run-duration.formula: Virtual seconds from run-start to run-end, or to the last event while the run is open. Taken from the ledger's event times, never from the wall clock.

model-calls.formula: agent-run steps whose journaled output carries a cost. Model judges are not counted: the ledger does not journal their cost.

model-cost.formula: Sum of cost.usd over the journaled agent-run steps. Model judges are not counted.

model-tokens.formula: Sum of every count named *_tokens in the journaled agent-run costs. When no step reported a token count the value is not recorded.

task-reruns.formula: Task starts after the first start of the same key: rework rounds and retries.

judge-failures.formula: Acceptance rubric items a judge failed. A pending (unsampled) item is not a failure.

gate-wait.formula: Virtual seconds from start to acceptance of every task execution that evaluated a listen until or consumed a signed decision.

session-tool-calls.formula: tool_call records in the session record exported for the turn.

session-tool-errors.formula: tool_result records with is_error in the session record exported for the turn.

session-compactions.formula: compaction records in the session record exported for the turn.
